title: A Collective has a network home: one shared calendar and a directory of its member Spaces
detail: PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on the collaborator calendar. Required before Founding Collective sells.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};if(!fs.existsSync("app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/network/page.tsx"))fail("no network home page");console.log("ok: the network home exists")'
